::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Raised a $24M all-equity seed round in November 2026 (led by Info Edge, South Park Commons and Indusbridge Ventures; Micromax, Valour Capital and Gaingels participating). About 75 staff across India and Santa Clara; CTO Boyd Fowler was previously CTO at OmniVision. Design wins with General Atomics and Kaynes Semicon; pre-revenue, with commercial production targeted for 2027. Stays fabless for sensors; a separate fab project announced in 2024 with a US Space Force technology partnership 'remains in development' and is not funded by this round.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Image sensors that integrate image capture, signal processing and AI inference on a single chip, replacing a separate sensor, ISP and SoC — the company claims at least 70% lower system cost. Gen-1 in prototyping; Gen-2 prototypes expected mid-2027.
